name: masset-mcp-tools
description: Free MCP tools for marketers from Masset. First up: Did It Win?, an honest A/B test verdict with an inline results card.

scripts.build:did-it-win: cross-env INPUT=tools/did-it-win/mcp-app.html vite build && node scripts/embed-html.mjs did-it-win
scripts.build:chess: cross-env INPUT=tools/chess/mcp-app.html vite build && node scripts/embed-html.mjs chess
scripts.build:masset-guide: cross-env INPUT=tools/masset-guide/mcp-app.html vite build && node scripts/embed-html.mjs masset-guide
scripts.build: npm run build:did-it-win && npm run build:chess && npm run build:masset-guide && tsc --noEmit
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "cross-env INPUT=tools/did-it-win/mcp-app.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
